What we noticed

    Your next step

    This is an educational warning-sign check, not proof that a message is fraudulent or a URL is safe. We do not open links or check live reputation databases.

    Checks run in your browser only. Content isn't uploaded or saved by this app.

    THE GOLDEN RULE

    Stop. Check. Verify.

    A convincing message can still be a scam. Take a moment before you act.

    01
    Pause before clicking

    Don't tap unexpected links or install unfamiliar apps.

    02
    Protect your details

    Never share OTPs, passwords or financial details through a message.

    03
    Verify independently

    Contact the organization using a website or phone number you find yourself.

    ✳A little skepticism can save a lot of trouble.
    HOW IT WORKS

    Built to inform.
    Not to spy.

    Transparent rules, understandable results, and no hidden uploads. Your privacy shouldn't be the price of staying safe.

    Pattern awareness
